summary: Frontend-only regression test of Dashboard.js refactor where LikedTab, SubleasesTab and GovernmentServicesTab were extracted into self-contained components. Logged in as renter@test.com and exercised every extracted tab plus the unchanged Properties/Alerts/top-right Sublease Property button. All critical interactions work. No regressions detected; refactor appears clean.
verified_flows: Login as renter -> session token persisted in sessionStorage -> /dashboard renders with all tabs (tab-properties, tab-bookings, tab-subleases, tab-settings, tab-services, tab-alerts, tab-liked)

tab-liked: LikedTab renders 'Liked Properties' heading; two existing liked properties displayed with unlike-btn heart buttons. Empty-state branch inspected in source (browse-properties-btn wired to /properties/all).
tab-subleases: hero 'Sublease Your Property' + '+ New Sublease' button renders. Clicking opens form showing 'Step 1: Select the property you're renting'. Existing sublease card renders.
tab-subleases: Pause/Activate toggle successfully flipped 'Pause' -> 'Activate' (PUT /api/subleases/{id}) and back.

tab-subleases: Remove button opens a toast.custom confirmation (NOT window.confirm). Cancel + Remove buttons visible; Cancel dismisses and sublease remains. confirm-delete-sublease-{id} data-testid present and targetable.

tab-subleases: pre-existing sublease has contract -> 'Copy Signing Link' button present; clicking toggled button text to 'Copied!' (3s state). navigator.clipboard called with `${origin}/sign/{token}`.
tab-services: GovernmentServicesTab renders all required fields: gov-fullname-input, gov-id-input, gov-address-input, gov-service-type-select, gov-notes-input, gov-submit-btn.
tab-alerts: clicked without crash (previously extracted component unchanged).
tab-properties (unchanged): renter role hides add-property-button (expected — renter is not an owner). No crash when clicking tab.
Top-right 'Sublease Property' button (data-testid=sublease-property-button) correctly switches active tab to Subleases.
Rapid tab switching (liked <-> subleases <-> services) cleanly remounts components without errors.
not_verified: Unlike removal (POST /api/properties/{id}/like) — intentionally skipped to avoid mutating pre-seeded liked-properties state; wiring verified via code review only.

Contract PDF upload on a sublease without contract — the only existing sublease already has a contract, so upload-contract-{id} button was not present to exercise at runtime. Code path in SubleasesTab.handleContractUpload validates file type and posts multipart to /api/subleases/{id}/contract.
console_warnings: React warning: 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute jsx' — pre-existing, unrelated to this refactor (emitted from some styled-jsx/legacy component).
One 404 on a resource (asset/endpoint) — appears unrelated to extracted tabs; not triggered by tab interactions directly.
critical_code_review_comments: SubleasesTab.jsx uses a SINGLE useRef (fileRef) shared across ALL sublease rows. If the user has multiple subleases awaiting contract upload, all of them will share one hidden <input type=file> and its onChange closure captures the sublease id via handleContractUpload(sub.id, ...) — but because the same input is rendered per row inside the loop, the effective `ref` callback last-wins. Works for single sublease, but could misfire uploads to the wrong sublease when >1 row needs upload. Recommend moving <input type=file> outside the map with state-tracked targetSubleaseId, or use one ref per row via object ref map.
SubleasesTab.jsx fetchRenterBookings does N+1 property GETs inside Promise.all for each booking. Fine for small lists, but consider a bulk endpoint or caching if bookings grow.

LikedTab.jsx fetches liked properties in a useEffect with empty deps — when the tab is remounted via tab click the fetch runs, which is fine, but if the Dashboard re-mounts the component on every tab switch, stale state is OK. Verify Dashboard.js mounts/unmounts these tabs (not just toggles CSS). If conditionally rendered, data is always fresh which is correct behaviour.
Dashboard.js is still 1944 lines after refactor. Consider extracting PropertiesTab and AddPropertyModal next to continue the split.
action_items: (Optional/minor) Fix SubleasesTab shared fileRef issue — move the hidden file input out of the map or maintain per-row refs to guarantee correct target when multiple subleases await contract upload.
(Optional) Investigate pre-existing 'non-boolean attribute jsx' React console warning (not blocking, not introduced by this refactor).

The one latent issue worth watching: SubleasesTab uses a single shared fileRef inside a .map() — won't surface until a renter has 2+ subleases without contracts. When adding more tabs/flows, keep renter role in mind: renter cannot add properties (no add-property-button rendered), so Property-tab tests need an owner login.
